title: Organic and Urban Farming
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the basis of organic farming."
A living soil is the basis of organic farming.

Mix cropping is the outstanding feature of organic farming in which variety of crops are grown simultaneously or at different time on the same land.

Mulching means covering the ground with a layer of loose material such as compost, manure, straw, dry grass, leaves or crop residues.

Horticulture is the branch of plant agriculture dealing with garden crops, generally fruits, vegetables, and ornamental plants.

Soil management practice is the process of maintaining the soil in good condition and improving its quality and nutritional status by protecting it from direct sunlight and from the impact of rainfall and wind erosion.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the botanical pesticides used in organic farming. 4."

Greenhouse technology is the most effective way to achieve the goal of protected cultivation since it provides favorable and controlled environment for the crop to grow and give high productivity round the year.

Landscape horticulture is a broad category that includes plants for the landscape, including lawn turf but particularly nursery crops such as shrubs, trees, and vines.

Shade nets are used to cut down the solar radiations and protect the crops from wilting or scorching.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the wholeness and integrity of living systems."
Health is the wholeness and integrity of living systems.

Farmyard manure (FYM) is the traditional material used to maintain and improve soil fertility and it consists of straw or other bedding, mixed with animal faeces and urine.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as a production system that avoids or largely eliminates the usage of synthetic compounded fertilizers, growth regulators, pesticides, and farm animal feed additives."
Organic farming is defined as a production system that avoids or largely eliminates the usage of synthetic compounded fertilizers, growth regulators, pesticides, and farm animal feed additives.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a sustainable and environmentally friendly production method that contributes to poverty alleviation and food security among small scale farmers."
Organic agriculture is a sustainable and environmentally friendly production method that contributes to poverty alleviation and food security among small scale farmers.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means reducing the effects of weeds on crop growth and yield."
Weed control means reducing the effects of weeds on crop growth and yield.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the most common pests and diseases control methods in vegetables crops in spite of their harmful such as safety and the development of resistance to the pesticide."
Pesticides are the most common pests and diseases control methods in vegetables crops in spite of their harmful such as safety and the development of resistance to the pesticide.
